spans.s:
mfn. (-रुः-रुः-र्व्वी-रु)
1 Large, great.
2 Much, excessive.
3

Long.
4

Valuable, precious.
E.
ऊर्णु to cover, कु Uṇādi affix; ऊ is made short, and ण dropped by special rule.

m. (-रुः)
The thigh.
E.
ऊर्णु to cover, कु aff.

m. (-लः)
A creeper, (Cucumis colocynthis.)
E.
उरु and काल time, of long growth; also with कन् added उरुकालकः.

m. (-यः)
A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
उरग a snake, इ to go, and अच् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Greater, larger.
E.
उरु and तरप् aff.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Greatest.
E.
उरु and तमप्.

m. (-पः)
Great heat. उरु much, ताप heat.

n. (-त्वं)
Magnitude, vastness.
E.
उरु and त्व affix; also उरुता.

m. (-र्गः)
A long road.
E.
उरु and मार्गं a road.

ind.
A particle, of,
1

Assent.
2
Expansion: see उररी.

ind.
A particle of,
1

Promise.
2
Of expansion: see ऊररी.

m. (-कः)
The castor-oil tree, (Palma christi or Ricinus communis).
E.
उरु great or much, (disease,) वै to wither or dry, affix उक deriv. irr. or with ऊक affix उरुवूक.

m. (-कः)
See the preceding.

m. (-चाः)
A malignant sprite, an imp or goblin.
E.
उरु much, व्यच to deceive, असुन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-त्त्वः-त्त्वा-त्त्वं)
Magnanimous, of a lofty nature.
E.
उरु and सत्त्व disposition.

m. (-रः)
A valuable necklace.
E.
उरु and हार a necklace.

f. (-निः)
Weakness of the thigh.
E.
ऊरु and ग्लानि debility.

m. (-जः)
A Vaiśya or man of the third tribe.
E.
ऊरु and ज born; from the thigh of BRAHMĀ.

mfn. (-ध्नः-ध्नी-ध्नं)
As high as the thigh.
E.
ऊरु and दध्नच् affix; also ऊरुद्वयस and ऊरुमात्र, with द्वयसच् and मात्रच् affs.

n. (-र्व्व)
The knee.
E.
ऊरु and पर्व्वन् a joint.

m. (-म्भः)
1 Paralysis of the lower extremities.
2 Rheumatism of the thigh.
f. (-म्भा)
The plantain tree.
E.
ऊरु and स्तम्भ a post.
